description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49), not yet finalized. verdict: "failed" alongside error is rejected (VERDICT_ERROR_CONFLICT). error means the harness produced no usable result, so no outcome can have been judged; "failed" asserts that one was. With error present, verdict MUST be absent or "unverified". This is the strict starting point on purpose: relaxing it later (for example, if 'provably never reached the provider' should count as failed) is backward compatible, tightening it later would not be. Expressed in spec/schemas/resultset.json with if/then/const, so the raw JSON Schema and both hand-rolled validators all reject this document. A conforming validator MUST REJECT it.
